jobs.title: Revenue and Billing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
BUILD A SAFER WORLD.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM's Finance team keeps revenue and billing accurate, automated, and audit-ready as the company scales. As our Revenue and Billing Operations Manager, you will own the billing function and be a key contributor to revenue accounting, building scalable processes, replacing manual work with automation, and ensuring our records and controls are always audit-ready. You’ll have the opportunity to shape the function from a lean base—deciding what to automate, building the right controls, and creating processes that can scale with TRM.

The Impact You Will Have:

 - Automate manual billing work, reconciliations, invoice generation, exception flagging, and data validation, building AI-assisted workflows and owning the review and controls that ensure accuracy and audit readiness.

 - Strengthen revenue accounting so our records are accurate and consistently audit-ready, using AI to accelerate reconciliations and documentation while you verify what touches the books.

 - Evaluate and implement billing solutions that fit how TRM works, using AI to compare options, assess tradeoffs, and model impact.

 - Build a prioritized automation roadmap: decide what to automate first and next, and measure the time it gives back to the team.

 - Build scalable, resilient billing processes that keep pace with growth and reduce key-person dependency.

 - Partner with Sales, Legal, and Accounting to evaluate how contracts and policies are structured and their downstream billing impact.

What We're Looking For:

 - Demonstrated AI fluency: you can identify which finance processes to automate, build the workflows, and articulate where AI output must be verified before it is trusted.

 - Senior experience across revenue accounting and billing operations.

 - Hands-on experience leading the evaluation and implementation of billing solutions and automating billing or finance processes.

 - Experience leading external audits and building and maintaining audit-ready processes and controls.

 - Strategic judgment on automation sequencing and designing effective, scalable controls.

 - A hands-on, builder mindset: you’re comfortable operating in the details, solving problems directly, and doing the work yourself as part of a lean team.

 - Clear cross-functional communication with Sales, Legal, and Accounting.

About the Team:

 - Finance is lean and fast-moving; this role adds senior capacity and redundancy to revenue and billing.

 - You will have real ownership and the mandate to modernize the function, not just maintain it.

 - The work is demanding: doing more with less, ahead of a first-year audit, on a team that moves fast.

Team Operating Rhythms:

 - The team is distributed, not distant, with strong async communication and US working-hours overlap.

 - Close collaboration with Sales/Deal Desk, Accounting, and Legal.

Learn About TRM Speed:

 - Within the first 90 days, automate at least one high-volume manual billing process end to end with documented controls.

 - In the first 30 days, map the full revenue and billing process and identify the top automation opportunities.

 - Within the first two quarters, deliver an audit-ready improvement to revenue accounting ahead of the first-year audit.


APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.




INTERVIEWING WITH TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

 - Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

 - Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

 - First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

 - Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

 - References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

 - Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

 - Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.




AI FLUENCY AT TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

 - Accelerate repeatable workflows

 - Structure and solve problems

 - Improve output quality

 - Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.




LIFE AT TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

 - Priorities and targets to change quickly

 - Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

 - A high level of personal ownership and accountability

 - Close collaboration across teams and functions

 - Frequent, high-touch communication

 - Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

 - A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 




LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

 - Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

 - Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

 - Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.





JOIN OUR MISSION

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

 - Turn R&D performance into a clear executive and board narrative: what changed, why, and which decisions should follow.

 - Rebuild R&D finance around AI, automation, and Pigment so more time goes to shaping decisions and less to assembling reports.

 - You'll have substantial ownership from day one, direct exposure to the CTO and executive team, and room to shape how R&D finance operates.

 - The role is built to scale with its owner. Using AI and automation, you can expand what one person owns, and as the mandate grows there may be an opportunity to build a team.

 - We're distributed, not distant: written communication for clarity and context, live time for decisions and collaboration.

 - Regular working sessions with the CTO and R&D leaders, plus a monthly R&D cost and forecast review.

 - Quarterly planning with Talent and R&D on headcount capacity, and annual planning cycles in Pigment.

 - Slack and Notion for async updates; AI tools are part of the daily workflow.

 - Within your first 30 days, deliver an initial AI-assisted cloud forecast, focused on GCP with AWS coverage as applicable, that gives R&D leaders their first driver-based view of where infrastructure spend is heading.

 - Within your first 90 days, have the R&D capacity model integrated into the planning process so hiring decisions and budget move together.

The AI Customer Success function is being built from the ground up, and this role will help define it internationally. As the first Customer Success Manager in this area, you will own the end-to-end post-sale experience for a portfolio of customers that includes some of the world’s most sophisticated cyber threat intelligence teams and investigators, national security agencies, and financial crime teams. Your mandate is not just to manage accounts—you will help establish the playbook, define what success looks like, and drive a product-led growth motion that turns new customers into long-term, expanding partners.



THE IMPACT YOU WILL HAVE:

 - Build and ship a v1 onboarding playbook within the first 30 days—a practical, working version built from early customer engagements that can be iterated as you learn what drives adoption across international customer segments.

 - Use AI to build production CS workflows that pull from ChurnZero, Salesforce, Gong, and product usage telemetry to auto-generate account health summaries and QBR drafts—compressing hours of reporting preparation into minutes so you can spend your time on the work that actually requires human judgment.

 - Define and track adoption benchmarks across the portfolio—hands-on-keyboard usage, consumption rates, and account-specific success metrics—and surface at-risk accounts before renewal decisions are made.

 - Identify and scope the highest-impact PLG play within 60 days by working backwards from expansion targets, focusing on the one or two use cases most likely to drive consumption across the customer base.

 - Run executive business reviews and QBRs with senior stakeholders at government agencies and financial institutions internationally—building the trust and credibility that turns TRM from a vendor into a mission-critical partner.

 - Partner with ADs on expansion plays, co-own NRR targets, and build the structured path to proving value for every customer with an expiring or at-risk contract.

 - Close the feedback loop between customers and Product—synthesize adoption blockers, feature gaps, and new use-case opportunities into prioritized, actionable input that informs the roadmap.

 - Design the CS infrastructure and tooling stack that scales as the product grows—you are building the foundation the next CSM hire will inherit.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - Background in cyber or cyber threat intelligence, intelligence agencies, financial crime investigations, or regulatory and compliance environments.

 - 5+ years as an onboarding engineer, customer success manager, deployment strategist, or in another post-sale role with proven ownership of NRR, GRR, and expansion metrics—you have the track record, not just the title.

 - Domain credibility in cyber, national security, or financial crime—you can walk into a room of investigators and earn their trust in the first meeting, not the fifth.

 - Demonstrated zero-to-one builder experience—you have built a CS function, onboarding playbook, or PLG motion from scratch and can point to the specific outcomes it drove.

 - Production AI fluency—you have built real, repeatable AI workflows, not just experiments, that synthesize data from multiple sources into outputs that run consistently and deliver measurable results. You can show the workflow, explain the data logic, and articulate where human judgment stays in the loop.

 - A high level of independence—you set your own agenda, operate without needing constant direction, and ship v1 before you have all the answers.

 - Strong executive presence—you can run a QBR with a senior government stakeholder or financial institution executive and command the room through substance, not just polish.

 - Experience supporting international customers, with the ability to navigate regional, cultural, and time-zone differences.


ABOUT THE TEAM:

 - This team focuses on TRM’s AI-driven Intel platform, supporting investigators and cyber teams working on complex cases involving cyber threats.

 - This is the first Customer Success hire dedicated to international customers—you will help build the function from the ground up, with high autonomy, direct access to leadership, and meaningful influence on how TRM approaches customer success globally.

 - The broader TRM CS organization operates distributed, not distant—async-first communication through Slack, strong documentation, and intentional synchronous time for key decisions.

 - You will work directly with the Head of Customer Success and Patrick South, CRO, with close day-to-day collaboration with international Sales teams and Product.


TEAM OPERATING RHYTHMS:

 - As a globally distributed team, members work across multiple time zones. This role will primarily align its working hours and customer coverage with international markets, with flexibility to collaborate across regions when needed.

 - Our Customer Success team is fully remote, thriving on asynchronous communication and collaboration through Slack channels and detailed documentation. We hold weekly customer syncs, biweekly health syncs, join our associated POD calls, and regularly engage with customers across international markets. As experts in our craft, we focus on providing support, driving value, and building meaningful relationships with our customers as trusted advisors. We are on the front lines of TRM, ensuring our customers get the most out of the product and bringing valuable insights back to the team.

 - The team moves fast and iterates—v1 ships before it is perfect, and feedback is expected to be direct and specific.


ON-CALL RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - End-to-End Ownership: While there is no formal hourly rotation, you will be the primary lead for your area and responsible for customer success across international markets. This requires a high degree of agency and a commitment to seeing mission-critical tasks through to resolution, including the flexibility to handle urgent needs outside of standard hours or on weekends when they arise.


LEARN ABOUT TRM SPEED IN THIS POSITION:

 - Within 30 days of joining, you ship a working v1 onboarding playbook built from your first 2–3 accounts—not a slide deck, but a live document with measurable adoption benchmarks that the account team is already using to set customer expectations.

 - Within 6 weeks, you share a draft success-metrics framework at 50% complete with the account team and key customers to validate direction—getting real signal on what drives credit consumption before investing further in building out the full playbook.

 - Within 60 days, you identify and scope the highest-impact PLG play by working backwards from expansion targets—presenting a concrete recommendation to leadership on which use case to prioritize and why, grounded in actual account data from international customers.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

"At TRM, we believe the people we hire will determine how far and how fast we can go in our mission to build a safer world for billions of people. That’s why we’re building a Talent team that sees recruiting as a craft and a competitive advantage, people who challenge assumptions, move with urgency, and are energized by building exceptional teams to solve incredibly hard problems. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you."

– Alicia Strait https://www.linkedin.com/in/alicias11/, VP of Talent, TRM Labs

 

The people who build TRM’s Sales organization determine how far and how fast our mission travels. Every hire shapes the markets we win-from public sector and defense to financial institutions and crypto—and how effectively our blockchain intelligence reaches the front lines of financial crime.

As the Team Lead, Sales Recruiter, you’ll own TRM’s most critical searches across Sales and Go-to-Market while serving as a mentor and force multiplier for the recruiting pod. You’ll manage your own requisitions, but your impact will extend beyond your desk through team initiatives, stronger operating rhythms, shared best practices, and day-to-day peer leadership.

You’ll help the team operate as a cohesive, high-performing unit while prioritization, calibration, problem-solving, and execution. Your success will be measured by the quality, velocity, and business impact of your hires—as well as your ability to mentor teammates and elevate the performance of the broader Sales recruiting pod.

How this role differs from a Senior or Staff Recruiter: You’ll own not only your searches, but also the operating rhythm, unblocking, experimentation, and outcomes of the broader sales recruiting pod. You’ll set the standard for exceptional partnership with executive stakeholders and model excellence for the team.



The impact you'll have:

Leading the pod:

 - Run executive level Sales hiring syncs, driving the cadence, priorities, and follow-through for the team and its hiring managers.

 - Represent the Sales pod in headcount and workforce-planning discussions with Talent leadership, bringing the on-the-ground view from being closest to the department leads.

 - Bubble up what's happening across the Sales recruiting team — risks, wins, market signals, and blockers — so the manager and VP stay informed.

 - Drive solutioning and experimentation with the team, testing new sourcing angles, processes, and ideas and unblocking searches when they stall.

 - Help the team execute on retros and decision docs, turning what you learn into durable improvements.

 - Shape and roll out new processes and changes to the pod: when the team adopts a new way of working, much of it comes from you.



Owning your own searches:

 - Own full-cycle recruiting for Director+ Sales leadership searches across TRM's global Sales organization.

 - Act as a strategic talent partner to executive stakeholders; advising on market dynamics, candidate calibration, hiring strategy, and close approach.

 - Build and execute targeted sourcing strategies that identify, engage, and close exceptional Sales talent from high-growth technology, fintech, crypto, public sector, and financial services environments.

 - Develop deep market maps for priority searches that include competitive talent, high-performing corporate functions, and referral-driven networks.

 - Create an exceptional candidate experience for senior and specialized talent, so every touchpoint reflects TRM's talent bar, mission, and operating principles.

 - Use data, market insight, and funnel conversion metrics to diagnose search health, influence hiring teams, and adjust strategy in real time.

 - Serve as a craft leader on the Talent team, raising the bar for sourcing, stakeholder management, candidate engagement, and strategic search execution.



What we're looking for:

 - 10+ years of recruiting experience, with 7+ years of experience owning senior GTM and Sales leadership searches in high-growth technology companies.

 - Experience leading or setting direction for a recruiting pod including running hiring syncs, unblocking other recruiters' searches, and driving team experimentation — whether or not you've formally managed people.

 - A track record of taking operating overhead off a manager's plate: owning team cadence, process rollouts, retros, and decision docs so the group runs as a tight unit.

 - Proven success hiring senior and specialized talent across Sales and Sales Leadership

 - Strong search fundamentals including market mapping, talent intelligence, passive candidate engagement, confidential search management, and senior-level closing.

 - The ability to quickly understand complex corporate roles across sales functions.

 - Strong analytical ability to interpret recruiting metrics, funnel health, conversion rates, and pipeline quality, and translate them into action for yourself and the team.

 - Exceptional stakeholder management, building trust, influencing senior leaders, pushing back thoughtfully, and operating as a strategic advisor throughout the process.

 - Excellent written and verbal executive presence, including synthesizing market insight, candidate tradeoffs, and search progress clearly for executive audiences.

 - High ownership, persistence, and judgment in navigating ambiguous, confidential, business-critical searches.

 - A demonstrated ability to balance speed with quality while holding a high talent bar for sales hiring.



About the team:

 - Our talent team is fully remote and async-first. We keep work moving across time zones through Slack, thorough documentation, and proactive updates.

 - We stay tightly aligned through weekly hiring syncs, team sourcing syncs, and bi-weekly team meetings where we solve challenges together.

 - We care deeply about our craft: we continuously refine best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for candidates and internal stakeholders alike, backed by precise, reliable reporting.

 - We're globally distributed but most of us overlap between 7am–12pm PST for real-time collaboration.

 - Every team member, wherever they're based, maintains at least a 4-hour overlap with PST business hours.



Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

 - Within 72 hours of a role opening, you've scheduled the intake, researched and published the role, and brought 5 calibration profiles to the intake for the hiring manager to review.

 - Within a week of opening the role, you've mapped the total addressable market, built a shortlist of the top 30 profiles, conducted 5–10 recruiter screens, and stood up the full interview process — including the approved questions that define what good looks like on a recruiter screen.

 - Two weeks after the initial interviews, you analyze the data to identify what is and isn't driving pass rates and conversions, share insights and recommendations with the hiring team, and continue to monitor and adjust until the position is filled.
   
   Our Onboarding Process:
   
   - Within your first 30 days, you’ll be fully onboarded, calibrated, and operating as the DRI for your positions.
   
   - Within your first 60 days, you’ll have your first sourced candidates reaching final rounds.
   
   - Within your first 90 days, you’ll have made 2–3 hires.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

 - Priorities and targets to change quickly

 - Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

 - A high level of personal ownership and accountability

 - Close collaboration across teams and functions

 - Frequent, high-touch communication

 - Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

 - A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone.
